statement: For every integer d ≥ 0 and every rational set I ⊂ [0, 1] satisfying the descending chain condition, there is an integer alc(d, I) > 0 such that every normal projective integral lc pair (X, ∆) of dimension d, with coefficients in I and KX + ∆ ∼Q 0, satisfies alc(d, I)(KX + ∆) ∼ 0.
